stem.text: Green light is incident normally on a diffraction grating and forms a diffraction pattern on a distant screen.

stem.alt: Diagram of parallel green light arrows incident on a diffraction grating, with a screen labelled screen further along the same line.

stem.text: Which change, on its own, would **decrease** the separation of the diffraction maxima on the screen?

A.text: Increase the distance between the screen and the diffraction grating.

B.text: Replace the diffraction grating with a grating that has a smaller separation between the slits.

C.text: Replace the diffraction grating with a grating that has fewer slits per unit length.

D.text: Replace the green light with red light.
